_comment: Strings for the consent ledger — 'Who can see my record' (app/privacy/access.tsx and the ledger-backed sections of app/privacy/index.tsx). Registered at runtime by lib/api/consentLedgerQueries.ts with deep=true, overwrite=false, so merging these into lib/i18n/locales/en.json is safe at any time and makes the registration a no-op. 1:1 with consent_ledger.fr.json, same {{placeholders}}. NOTE: every sentence describing a grant's STATE, its BASIS, and the care-relationship explanations comes from the SERVER already translated (lang/{en,fr}/consent_ledger.php) — the hook sends ?lang=, so those are correct in both languages today. Only the chrome below lives here.

consentLedger.title: Who can see my record
consentLedger.subtitle: Access to your record, right now
consentLedger.hubCardDesc: Everyone who can open your record right now, and how to stop them
consentLedger.errorTitle: We could not check your access list
consentLedger.errorBody: Your record is not open to anyone new because of this — we simply could not read the list. Try again in a moment.
consentLedger.statActiveCaption: Facilities that can open your record
consentLedger.statExpiringCaption: Active access ending within a week
consentLedger.statEndedCaption: Expired or withdrawn — kept as history
consentLedger.statOtherCaption: Access that is not consent, and cannot be withdrawn here
consentLedger.activeHint: Each of these can open your record now. You can withdraw any of them.
consentLedger.activeEmptyBody: Nobody currently holds a consent grant over your record. Check the section below — a clinician treating you can still open it without one.
consentLedger.historyHint: Access that has ended. None of these can open your record.
consentLedger.historyEmptyBody: When access expires or you withdraw it, it moves here so you can still see that it existed.
consentLedger.relationshipsHint: Not consent grants. Withdrawing consent does not end these.
consentLedger.relationshipsEmptyBody: Nobody can open your record through an appointment, a care team, past treatment or an open episode of care.
consentLedger.confirmBody: {{facility}} will no longer be able to open your record. This takes effect immediately. You can grant access again later if you need to.
consentLedger.withdrawnNotice: {{facility}} can no longer open your record.
consentLedger.noClinicianNamed: No individual clinician is named on this one
consentLedger.truncatedBody: There is more access on your record than fits in one list. The counts above describe what is shown here, not everything there is.
